title: West Virginia lawmaker introduces bill to allow state crypto investments
summary: The legislation would allow the state‘s treasury to hold digital assets with a market capitalization of more than $750 billion, which applied only to Bitcoin as of January.

title: Behind the ‘Bitcoin lottery’ myth: NiceHash clarifies untagged BTC blocks
summary: Untagged Bitcoin blocks sparked solo-miner speculation before NiceHash confirmed they were mined during internal testing, highlighting limits of onchain attribution.

title: Coinbase CEO expects market structure bill markup ‘in a few weeks‘
summary: Brian Armstrong posted to social media late on a Wednesday saying Coinbase couldn't “support the bill as written,“ potentially leading to a postponement in consideration.

title: Bank of America CEO warns interest-bearing stablecoins could pull $6T from US banks
summary: In an earnings call transcript shared on X, BofA CEO Brian Moynihan pointed to studies suggesting yield-bearing stablecoins could draw trillions from the banking system.

title: Bitcoin whale balances see 21% bounce after fastest sell-off since 2023 ends
summary: Increasing Bitcoin whale balances highlight reaccumulation, aligning with renewed spot BTC ETF inflows. Will $100,000 become support soon?

title: US lawmakers demand action from SEC on Justin Sun enforcement case
summary: Three House Democrats warned that leaving the SEC's case against the Tron founder unresolved could ”undermine investors’ confidence” in the financial regulator.

title: CME Group to expand crypto futures with Cardano, Chainlink and Stellar contracts
summary: The planned altcoins listings will expand CME’s regulated crypto derivatives contracts beyond Bitcoin, Ether, XRP and Solana.

title: Bitcoin’s renewed push to $100K sparked by fresh institutional demand
summary: Sustained US Bitcoin ETF inflows are supporting prices near $97,000, raising questions about whether institutional demand is reshaping Bitcoin’s market cycle.

title: Bitcoin must hold $94K next, says trader as BTC price dips at US open
summary: Bitcoin halted its bullish BTC price rebound to dip below $96,000 on news that Middle East geopolitical tensions were easing.

title: These three XRP charts hint at a price rally toward $2.80
summary: XRP’s technical and onchain signals hint at a bullish breakout, with bulls eyeing a significant rally toward $2.80 by the month’s end.
